title: Polynomial-time PIT pair transformation
statement: The following function on bit strings is polynomial-time computable: on input $x$, return the PIT reduction string formed from the two components of $x$ when both components pass the validity test and their decoded variable strings have equal length; return the empty string otherwise. In the valid case, the reduction string is the one assembled from the parsed circuits and their evaluations modulo the encoded prime, as specified by the PIT transformation.
caveat: The formal statement names a function whose nested PIT parsing and reduction operations are not informally defined in the supplied definitions, so the valid-case description cannot be made more explicit without risking inaccuracy.
